A later 2024 nutrition update changed the SNOMED hierarchy and description wording on the same line without reintroducing the duplicated word. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the exact non-substantive typo requested by FHIR-18797 is already absent from the current active source.
